what: Mika in her Nine-Tailed Flame Empress form, a chibi fox-girl heroine: big red-orange fox ears, very long flowing red hair with gold hair ornaments, amber eyes, ornate white and gold armour with red trim and red gem accents, a layered red and white battle dress, white and gold boots, NINE big fluffy fox tails fanned out behind her in a wide half circle like a halo, each tail cream-white at the base turning orange-red with a flame-shaped red tip, a long-hafted crescent moon glaive with a huge curved orange-gold flame crescent blade
pose: She stands regal and tall like an empress, holding the crescent moon glaive upright in her right hand beside her with the end of its haft resting on the ground and the huge flame crescent blade high above her shoulder, her left hand resting lightly on her hip, a serene confident smile, all NINE fluffy fox tails fanned out wide behind her like a blazing halo.
idle: a regal idle: her body, face, hands, glaive and boots stay still; the NINE tails keep exactly their fan arrangement, sizes and shapes and only their flame tips ripple, one tail after another, like a slow wave travelling along the fan from the lowest tail on the left, over the top, to the lowest tail on the right, each tip settling back once the wave passes; no tail ever jumps, vanishes or swaps places; her fox ears twitch once (frames 3-4).
fidgets: all nine tails spread out a little wider and rise a little higher like a peacock's fan (only about one fifth bigger than in Image 1, the outermost tail tips staying well inside the cell with a wide margin), their flame tips flaring brighter (frames 2-4), held proudly at full spread (frame 5), folding halfway back (frame 6), then back to their exact resting places (frame 7). Each tail keeps its place in the fan order. Her body, face, hands, glaive and boots stay exactly in place. All flames are clean opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, never smoke, glow haze or loose sparks.

a compact baton twirl: she lifts the crescent glaive and grips its haft at the middle (frame 2), twirls it once in a tight circle right in front of her body like a baton, the crescent blade at a new angle each frame and always staying inside the outline of her fanned tails (frames 3-5: blade at the top, then pointing forward-down, then pointing back-down), then plants the end of its haft back on the ground beside her with a firm tap, upright as in Image 1 (frame 6), where a small flat ring of flame flares at its base and vanishes (frames 6-7). Her legs, body and tails stay in place. All flames are clean opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, never smoke, glow haze or loose sparks.
entrance: her nine-tailed fox-fire summoning. Frame 1: no character yet, only nine small round fox-fire flames floating in a wide arc just above the ground where she will stand. Frame 2: the nine flames streak down to one point on the ground and shoot up as nine long tails of fire unfurling upward in a wide fan. Frame 3: the nine fire tails sweep inward and close around the centre into a tall blazing flame bud. Frame 4: the flame bud starts to open like a nine-petal flower of fire. Frame 5: the petals open wide and she is revealed standing in the centre holding her glaive, her nine tails still made of pure fire. Frame 6: her nine tails turn from fire into her real fluffy tails fanned out behind her, flame tips burning. Frame 7: the last petals of fire curl away at her feet. Frame 8: exactly the resting pose of Image 1, no extra flames. All flames are clean opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, never smoke, glow haze or loose sparks. Keep every part inside its cell with margin.
